resources.string: Choose and crop an image to create or update a home-screen shortcut, or restore the default icon. Full configuration transfers include the custom image. The app drawer and system settings retain the APK icon; shortcut changes require launcher support.

Added per-module import and export alongside full configuration transfer. Imports do not restore permissions, caches or running tasks. Module manifests and configuration contracts prepare for a future 3.0.0 host; dynamic installation and removal are not yet available. Fixed a lingering to-do summary notification when import suspends scheduling.
